definitions.gloss: to add, to append, to supplement
definitions.explanation: To include additional information, items, or elements to something already existing.

examples.japanese: もう{一言|ひとこと}{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える。
examples.english: Let me add one more word.

examples.japanese: {説明|せつめい}に{具体例|ぐたいれい}を{付|つ}け{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added concrete examples to the explanation.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}に{一|ひと}つだけ{付|つ}け{加|くわ}えさせていただきます。
examples.english: Allow me to add just one more thing at the end.

notes:
A compound verb from {付|つ}ける (to attach) + {加|くわ}える (to add). Means to supplement or append something to what already exists.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the thing being added

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一言|ひとこと}{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a word/remark
- {補足|ほそく}を{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a supplement
- {情報|じょうほう}を{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add information
- {条件|じょうけん}を{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a condition
- {説明|せつめい}を{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add an explanation

USAGE:
Commonly used in speeches, meetings, and writing when supplementing a point. The polite form {付|つ}け{加|くわ}えさせていただきます (allow me to add) is standard in formal settings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加|くわ}える: to add (simpler, broader)
- {追加|ついか}する: to add, to append (more formal, often for data/items)
